$comment: Scaffold manifest for presale (chief-wiggum#236). apply_pattern.py stamps each file into the target repo with parameters bound. These are EXPERIMENT scaffolds, not product code: an honest pre-order page + a checkout stub the operator wires to a REAL payment provider after pre-registering the strength-5 test card (assumption.py). Existing targets are skipped unless --force.

files.desc: Honest pre-order page: not-built-yet framing, price {{price_usd}}, delivery window, and the refund policy — all BEFORE the payment step.
Checkout stub posting to {{checkout_endpoint}}; states in-file that it must be wired to a real payment provider — a simulated charge invalidates the strength-5 claim.
Binding note: pre-register the strength-5 assumption.py test card BEFORE launch; verdict only against the original journaled threshold hash; refund-on-kill wiring.
